lines: Avoiding towns and crossing over several mountains, we had finally made it to Maesaki City, the closest city to Gosha.
Phew, I think we somehow managed to lose them.
Haa... haa... It's been quite a while since I ran this much.
Good thing Heberybody managed to ride in the back of that truck on the way.
That damn masked woman, I didn't expect her to even hire mercenaries. She's really trying to get rid of Saya at all costs without exposing herself to "G."
We're almost to Gosha. Hold on for a little bit longer.
As we were talking, a fireball suddenly rained from the sky and crashed into the ground before us.
Uwaaah!? Wh-What was that!? A meteorite!?
How long are ya gonna keep on runnin'!?
A familiar voice echoed from the middle of the sparks the impact had sent flying.
Too bad though! I'll burn y'all alive! Oh, and I'll be taking Saya NEO from ya.
Who had appeared was Hestia, one of the pursuers from "G."
How did you know where to find us!?
Judging from how the soldiers had behaved earlier at the construction site, most likely a transmitter or something like that had been implanted into Saya's body.
Fuma! What do we do!? She's pretty strong, isn't she!?
We had fought her before, so we had some data on her. But the same was true for her.
What're y'all just standin' around for?!
But before I even had time to make a plan, Hestia's flames licked at my feet.
Yer the one with the "brains," so I'll crush ya first!!!
Another attack. I stumbled as I lost my footing, as well as my hold on Saya.
Gotcha! I'll turn ya into spit roast!!!
Another flame sparked to life in Hestia's modified arm.
At the last moment, electricity ran through Hestia's arm.
Her flames sprayed in the wrong direction, setting fire to weeds that had been growing beside some flower beds.
Hebiko stretched out her octopus tentacles to rescue Saya and me out of the sea of fire.
What in the? Looks like ya still don't know when to give up...
However, the next attack was immediately aimed at me.
This time I'll crush ya for sure!
H-H-Hey, wait!! Y-Y-Y-You'll have to d-d-d-d-deal with me first!!!
To my amazement, Shikanosuke had jumped in front of Hestia.
The reason he looked to be trembling was not simply because of the electricity he had gathered around his body though.
Hm? Ain't you the kid who threw that lousy shuriken at me the other day?
Do ya wanna get burned for good this time? Huh?
N-No! I-I'm gonna beat you this time! B-B-B-Better prepare yourself!!
Shikanosuke was backing away slowly, but his gaze was fixed on Hestia.
Hebiko! Look after Fuma and Saya NEO!
G-Got it... But your legs are shaking, Shikanosuke-chan!
Th-There are times when a man has to fiiight!
What he said sounded cool, but he looked like he was about to cry and his legs were trembling furiously.
Shikanosuke-chan, you kind of look cool and uncool at the same time!
What, yer kinda funny, kid. I'll do my best to roast ya well done!!!
The largest flame she had created so far formed in Hestia's hand.
Determined, Shikanosuke gathered electricity around him.
Hmph, I guess you never learn. That ain't gonna work on me, you should remember from last ti...!!?
Battery on! Eat this, Bambi-no Spark!!!
Before Hestia could unleash her flame, a powered-up electric fawn attacked her.
Wahahaha! What is that!? Are ya kiddin' me!? An electric deer!?
Hestia laughed loudly at Shikanosuke's attack.
The electric fawn jumped at Hestia's arm.
What, something like that ain't gonna work against my cyborg arm...!
Sparks shot out wildly from her cyborg arm.
It was over in a second, and it looked like there were no scratches on her arm, butー
Uaaarrgh!? My arm!? What'd ya do to it, ya little shit!?
And why are ya out of breath!?
S-Static electricity has a weak current, but a super high voltage!!
Even though it had been only for a second, the electrical arm had been short-circuited by the high voltage of static electricity and could no longer be used as a weapon.
That's why static electricity and machines don't mix! Remember that!
Hrm, ya scared the shit outta me... Whatever! My legs are enough for ya!
F-Fuma! What are you doing!? Go ahead already, hurry!
J-Just goooo!!! Just let a man do his thing!!!
A-Alright. Don't you die on me, Shikanosuke.
Spurred on by the desperate look on Shikanosuke's face, we started running.
It was now the middle of the night. We were running down an old road without any street lights, relying only on the moonlight.
Hidden alongside this road was the start of a mountain path. That was the entrance to the path leading to Gosha.
That scaredy-cat allowed us to come this far. We have to do all we can to bring Saya back to Gosha.
Hebiko quickly stopped me and pointed at the tip of her octopus tentacle. That was the sign that her sucker sensors had detected something.
You there, behind the rock! Come out already!
Phew, finally you're here. I thought you had gotten killed by those "G" guys.
